response:
It sounds really exhausting and hurtful to be called names, especially when it feels unfair and one-sided. You deserve to be treated with respect, and it's completely valid to feel tired of this.

One thing you might try is setting a clear boundary by calmly telling them how their words affect you and that you want the name-calling to stop. If they continue, it's okay to limit your interactions with them or walk away when it happens. Surrounding yourself with people who treat you kindly can also make a big difference. If this is happening at school or work, consider talking to a trusted adult, counselor, or supervisor who can help address the situation. You don't have to handle this alone, and your feelings matter.
